nodes.description: Constant uint256 cap of 2000 total NFTs for Superpunk.
Constant uint256 of 500 tokens reserved for the team.
Constant uint256 = MAX_NFT_SUPPLY - TEAM_RESERVE, the public sale cap.
Private counter minted upwards from 0 when mint direction is forward.
Private counter minted downwards from MAX_NFT_SUPPLY-1 when direction is reverse.
Public counter of team-reserved tokens minted so far.
Immutable address of the OpenSea ProxyRegistry used for operator whitelisting.
Superpunk constructor: stores proxy registry address and base URI.
Public view returning the current tiered price based on supply minus reserve.
onlyOwner function minting up to TEAM_RESERVE tokens to msg.sender.
Payable public mint allowing up to 20 NFTs with exact ether payment.
onlyOwner function transferring the whole contract balance to msg.sender.
Overrides ERC721 approval check to whitelist the OpenSea proxy.
Caller-controlled address used as mint recipient, recipient of funds and approval subject.
msg.sender.transfer(balance) sends the entire contract balance to an untrusted address.
reserveMintedCount.add(count) SafeMath addition on user-supplied count.
totalSupply().add(numberOfNfts) SafeMath addition bounding the mint loop.
getNFTPrice().mul(numberOfNfts) == msg.value price verification.
_safeMint performs an external onERC721Received call to the recipient contract.
External call proxyRegistry.proxies(owner) to the configured registry address.
count parameter of mintTeamReserve.
numberOfNfts parameter of mintNFT.
owner parameter of isApprovedForAll.
operator parameter of isApprovedForAll.
__name constructor parameter.
__symbol constructor parameter.
_uri constructor parameter for base URI.
_proxyRegistryAddress constructor parameter.
mintDirection computed from blockhash in mintTeamReserve.
mintIndex derived from the direction in mintTeamReserve.
Loop counter i in mintTeamReserve.
currentSupply = totalSupply() - reserveMintedCount in getNFTPrice.
balance = address(this).balance in withdraw.
mintDirection computed from blockhash in mintNFT.
mintIndex derived from the direction in mintNFT.
Loop counter i in mintNFT.

edges.reason: MAX_SALE_COUNT is derived from MAX_NFT_SUPPLY minus TEAM_RESERVE.
getNFTPrice rejects sales beyond the MAX_NFT_SUPPLY derived limit.
mintNFT enforces totalSupply below MAX_SALE_COUNT.
mintTeamReserve enforces reserveMintedCount <= TEAM_RESERVE.
reserveMintedCount is read and updated in mintTeamReserve.
reserveMintedCount is the base operand of the SafeMath addition.
mintTeamReserve executes reserveMintedCount.add(count).
User-supplied count is added to reserveMintedCount.
count drives the reserve minting loop.
msg.sender receives the team-reserved tokens minted by the owner-only function.
msg.sender is both the payer and the recipient in mintNFT.
withdraw sends the whole contract balance to the untrusted msg.sender.
withdraw performs msg.sender.transfer(balance).
The transfer recipient is the untrusted msg.sender.
numberOfNfts bounds and drives the public mint loop.
numberOfNfts is added to totalSupply() in the supply check.
mintNFT executes totalSupply().add(numberOfNfts).
mintNFT verifies getNFTPrice().mul(numberOfNfts) == msg.value.
getNFTPrice result is multiplied by the requested count.
forwardMintIndex is incremented when the direction is forward in mintTeamReserve.
reverseMintIndex is decremented when the direction is reverse in mintTeamReserve.
forwardMintIndex is incremented in mintNFT.
reverseMintIndex is decremented in mintNFT.
mintTeamReserve calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
mintNFT calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
onERC721Received may re-enter mintNFT before the mint loop completes.
onERC721Received may re-enter mintTeamReserve during the mint loop.
The callback is invoked with msg.sender as the operator argument.
proxyRegistryAddress is the target of the proxy lookup.
isApprovedForAll queries ProxyRegistry.proxies(owner).
External call into the configured proxy registry during approval checks.
The constructor stores proxyRegistryAddress.
__name is forwarded to the ERC721 constructor.
__symbol is forwarded to the ERC721 constructor.
_uri is passed to _setBaseURI in the constructor.
_proxyRegistryAddress is stored in the constructor.
owner parameter is used for the proxy and super approval checks.
operator parameter is compared against the proxy owner.
Local mintDirection selects forward or reverse minting in mintTeamReserve.
Local mintIndex is the token id minted in mintTeamReserve.
Loop counter i controls the mintTeamReserve iteration.
currentSupply is computed by subtracting reserveMintedCount from totalSupply().
Local balance reads address(this).balance in withdraw.
The local balance is the amount transferred to msg.sender.
Local mintDirection selects forward or reverse minting in mintNFT.
Local mintIndex is the token id minted in mintNFT.
Loop counter i controls the mintNFT iteration.

normalization_plan.reason: count is only consumed by the reserveMintedCount.add(count) arithmetic operation.
numberOfNfts is directly consumed by totalSupply().add(numberOfNfts).
owner is only used by the isApprovedForAll override body.
operator is only used by the isApprovedForAll override body.
__name is only forwarded from the Superpunk constructor.
__symbol is only forwarded from the Superpunk constructor.
_uri is only consumed by the constructor via _setBaseURI.
_proxyRegistryAddress is only assigned in the constructor.
mintDirection is a temporary value local to mintTeamReserve.
mintIndex is a temporary value local to the mintTeamReserve loop.
Loop counter i is local to mintTeamReserve.
currentSupply is a temporary value local to getNFTPrice.
balance is read solely to be transferred by the withdraw external call.
mintDirection is a temporary value local to mintNFT.
mintIndex is a temporary value local to the mintNFT loop.
Loop counter i is local to mintNFT.
